name: stored_qubit_entanglement
label_authority: Consensus run of 18 Oct 2026 as summarized in QUESTION.md. Every number is the tool's claim, not checked against the papers; no human verification.
identity_rule: DOI or verified work identity; title-only matches require adjudication
question: Which experiments have demonstrated remote entanglement between qubits stored in quantum memories, and what entanglement rate, fidelity, storage (memory) time and entanglement-swapping result did each report?
reference: Consensus run, 18 Oct 2026. Only the summary table in notes/test-questions/stored-qubit-entanglement/QUESTION.md survives; the full answer was not kept. Titles for five targets were filled from the Elicit export of the heralded-memory question by DOI; the rest have no title in the reference.
expected_direction: Three groups: direct memory-memory entanglement, swapping of stored links, and platforms reporting rate, fidelity and storage together. Main claim: only the NV three-node network (Pompili 2021) reports a swap from stored states together with rate and memory metrics - 1 pair per 40 s, swapped fidelity 0.551(13), T2* 11.6 ms. Liu W.-Z. 2026 reports 0.554 at 450 ms with 550 +/- 36 ms storage but no swap; Knaut up to 1 Hz, 0.77(5) nuclear-spin fidelity, up to 1 s; Stephenson 182/s at 94% with no storage figure; Saha 97.0(4)% with 2.10 ms coherence. Davis 2025 is a photonic swap with no memory.

answer_elements.question: Fidelity per experiment, with the swapped fidelity kept apart from the link fidelity
Storage or memory time per experiment
Entanglement-swapping result per experiment, and whether only the NV three-node network reports a swap from stored states together with rate and memory metrics
The four metrics kept separate, "not reported" where a number is missing, and a memoryless photonic swap not presented as stored-qubit entanglement

pass_rule.status: draft from QUESTION.md, not confirmed by the owner
rules: Pompili 2021 reaches the answer with rate, swapped fidelity and memory time each cited from a located passage.
At least 4 of Liu W.-Z. 2026, Knaut 2023, Stephenson 2019, Saha 2024, Lago-Rivera 2021, Hermans 2021 are found; numbers come from passages, not abstracts alone where the abstract does not state them.
Answer keeps the four metrics separate and says "not reported" instead of filling gaps.
Davis 2025 is not presented as stored-qubit entanglement (no matter memory).
